import numpy as np

def test_seq(seq, n=256):
    seq = list(seq)
    if len(seq) < n:
        seq = seq + [seq[-1]]*(n-len(seq))
    seq = seq[:n]
    obs, _ = observe(params=None, actions=seq, n_steps=n)
    T = obs.shape[0]
    blue = obs[:, 26:28]; green = obs[:, 234:236]; red = obs[:, 104:106]
    d_blue = np.sqrt(((green-blue)**2).sum(1))
    d_red = np.sqrt(((green-red)**2).sum(1))
    return T, d_blue.min(), d_blue.argmin(), d_red.min(), d_red.argmin()

# single-burst patterns
print("=== [1]*k then 0 ===")
for k in [5,10,15,20,25,30,40,50,60,80,100,150]:
    T, db, ib, dr, ir = test_seq([1]*k)
    print(f"1x{k:3d}: T={T:3d} minD_blue={db:.3f}@{ib:3d} minD_red={dr:.3f}@{ir:3d}")

print("\n=== [1]*k then 2 ===")
for k in [10,20,25,30,40,50,60]:
    T, db, ib, dr, ir = test_seq([1]*k + [2]*200)
    print(f"1x{k}+2: T={T:3d} minD_blue={db:.3f}@{ib:3d} minD_red={dr:.3f}@{ir:3d}")
